Subject: Request: VPC enclave audit scope / limited remote access - Helmstone pilot

Hi Maya,

Thanks for the walkthrough last week. We're excited about getting a private deployment in our US region for the pilot. A couple of non-standard asks came up from our security and legal teams and we need to confirm these are acceptable before we proceed with procurement: 

- Audit access: We require the ability to perform a one-time onsite audit (up to 48 hours) during the pilot and quarterly remote reviews. Can you confirm if Redwood will allow in-person audit under a limited NDA?
- Data residency carveout: We need to guarantee that model inputs/outputs and logs for Helmstone accounts never leave the us-east-1 region.
- No remote shell: Our ops team cannot allow vendor shell access to customer VMs. We understand log streaming is acceptable.
- Commercial ask: Helmstone is pushing for a 20% first-year discount and a $50k one-time onboarding credit tied to the audit accommodations.

Attached is a short summary from our side. Please let us know if these items require exec signoff so we can move forward.

Best,
Laura Jensen
Head of Engineering
Helmstone Therapeutics

Thanks Maya — technical/legal summary and recommended controls below. Quoting Laura inline where helpful.

1) Region residency (us-east-1): doable. We can pin storage, model serving, and ephemeral caches to an us-east-1 private subnet. Need note: backups and long-term logs live in encrypted S3 with region restriction; we need Helmstone to accept a written SLA clause.

2) No remote shell: we can commit to no vendor interactive shell access. We will provide:
   - readonly aggregated observability via a read-only logs/metrics sink
   - live troubleshooting through guided sessions (customer runs commands or we operate on copies)

3) Onsite audit: we can allow a single escorted onsite audit for a maximum 48-hour window with scoped checklist. Constraints:
   - audit only within our customer-controlled airgapped node room at their data center or at their VPC with Redwood escort; no access to host-level secrets or HSMs.
   - audit scope must be pre-approved and limited to configurations and audit logs; no live kernel or root inspection.
   - legal requires a Statement of Work addendum and a liability carveout (standard).

4) Quarterly remote reviews: acceptable as security posture reviews (30–60 min) with pre-shared logs and summary artifacts.

Commercial ask: 20% first-year discount + $50k onboarding credit — recommended counter: 18% discount first-year plus $30k onboarding credit, contingent on external counsel signoff on audit addendum and completion of security questionnaire. Also propose timebox: pilot length 6 months, after which standard pricing resumes unless expanded. This reduces long-term unit economics impact.

Required approvers: Lauren (Revenue lead) and Marissa (Head of Sales) for discounts >15% and onboarding credits >$25k. Legal signoff: Aditya for the audit addendum.

If you want, I can draft the addendum language for Aditya to review.

—Karthik
Head of Applied ML Ops
Redwood Inference

Thanks team — reviewing. I'm comfortable approving a limited concession to keep this pilot moving given the strategic fit (life sciences vertical + potential expansion). Approval below: 

- Approve 18% first-year discount + $30k one-time onboarding credit.
- Approve escorted onsite audit: single 48-hour window during pilot; scope must be pre-approved and executed under Redwood escort. Quarterly remote reviews allowed (30–60 min).
- Approve strict us-east-1 residency clause for application data & logs; Redwood legal to add region-bound SLA language.
- No vendor shell access is required and agreed.

Conditions: 
1) Aditya to sign off on the audit addendum language and liability carveouts before DOCS signing.
2) Helmstone to sign a non-disclosure addendum and agree that any findings that require code or host-level changes are addressed via normal engineering change requests (no live kernel/root inspection).
3) Discount and credit apply to the first 12 months only; renewals revert to list pricing unless a new commercial cadence is agreed.

Lauren / Maya — please proceed to communicate this to Helmstone and route the audit addendum to Aditya for legal review. I'll sign the executive approval stub once Aditya confirms legal language.

-Marissa Cole
